card.title: IPhone XR Stuck in DFU, updates successfully but goes back to DFU

source.title: IPhone XR Stuck in DFU, updates successfully but goes back to DFU

symptoms: stuck in DFU after successful restore

claims.statement: iPhone XR that restores to 100% but returns to DFU (USB ~0.45 A, DCPS hangs ~45 mA) often has a cracked R0601 at the NAND corner, linking PP1V8_IO to SPI_AP_TO_S4E_MOSI_BOOT_CONFIG1; value 4.7 Ω.

procedure: Clear underfill around R0601 and poke it.
Replace R0601 (4.7 Ω) if it breaks.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
